title: Mode of Transport for Travellers Arriving into Singapore without COVID-19 Polymerase Chain Reaction Results
what_it_is: Mode of Transport for Travellers Arriving into Singapore without COVID-19 Polymerase Chain Reaction Results

sections.label: Charter bus health protocols
sections.summary: Private charter buses ferry travellers from checkpoints to SHN facilities under strict protocols including PPE, vaccination, testing, distancing and pre-departure PCR tests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: To minimise the risk of cross-infection and community spread, strict public health protocols are applied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: First, these private charter buses only ferry travellers from the checkpoints to the SHN facility.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Second, the bus drivers are trained to don the appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) including an N95 face mask, PPE gown and gloves.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: They are also fully vaccinated and subject to regular routine COVID-19 testing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Travellers are not allowed to sit near the driver and they only occupy the rear section of the vehicle.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The number of travellers allowed on each bus is also limited to less than half its total capacity to ensure adequate safe distancing between travellers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: In addition, all travellers from high-risk countries would need to have a negative Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) test taken not more than 72 hours before boarding a plane, ferry or vehicle bound for Singapore.

sections.label: Dedicated transport for higher-risk countries
sections.summary: For travellers from higher-risk countries, the approach is dedicated transport from the airport to the SHN facility to keep the mode of transport as secure as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, there may be instances of that which the Member may be referring to.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But the key point I would make is that for those who are from the higher risk countries, based on the categorisation we discussed earlier, the approach is to have dedicated transport from the airport to the SHN facility, so that the mode of transport is as secure as possible from a health perspective.
